issue_request: FHIR-36831 was an Applied/Persuasive Security issue asking how to encode admin-level or global consent policies that apply to all patients, groups, everyone, or non-patient resources. The final resolution says the Permission resource was updated with an overriding-policy use case.
initial_application: No core git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-36831 was found. The relevant historical core Permission source described organization-wide access-control policy, base policy that Consent builds upon, and non-patient examples; commit 22d8289602 later added directory-admin, directory-exclude, and residual Permission examples from Data Access Policies IG work.
additional_context: Permission is no longer an active core resource. Commit 0e2a8a7f83 removed source/permission and fhir.ini Permission build metadata, and rewired core Security/Privacy and history links to the Data Access Policies IG. Current core source links Permission externally. The current hl7.fhir.uv.dap package contains StructureDefinition-Permission and explicit overriding-policy examples. Later FHIR-54870 also notes the move to an incubator IG, but it is still Submitted.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No core source change was made because the requested Permission overriding-policy content is outside the active core build and is maintained in the external Data Access Policies IG.
